# Codexivo — instructions for AI coding assistants

Follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) at the repository root: it describes the architecture (`tokenize → parse → compile →
Machine`), the commands (`bun test`, `bun check`) and the conventions. The language design lives in
[`docs/especificacion-v1.md`](../docs/especificacion-v1.md); what works today, in [`docs/lenguaje.md`](../docs/lenguaje.md).

Before claiming a feature works, run it. Documentation in this repo must never describe behavior the code does not have.
